titre: Practice test — English (6th year primary) — Term 3

exercices.enonce:
Read the text:
Next week, Ines and her class will visit Tozeur on a school trip. They will travel by bus. Tozeur is famous for its palm trees and its old town. The pupils will bring healthy snacks: fruit, nuts and water. They will not bring sweets or chips. In the evening, they will watch a traditional dance show. Ines is very excited about the trip.

Answer:
1) Where will the class go next week? (1 pt)
2) How will they travel? (1 pt)
3) What healthy snacks will they bring? (1,5 pt)
4) What will they not bring? (1,5 pt)

Complete with: will / by / healthy / not
1) The class ...... visit Tozeur.
2) They will travel ...... bus.
3) Fruit and nuts are ...... snacks.
4) They will ...... bring sweets.
5) Ines ...... be excited.

Put each word in the right group (Food / Transport):
nuts - bus - fruit - train - water - bike
Food: ......   Transport: ......
